books.title: Peer-e-Kamil
books.short: One of the most widely read Urdu novels of its generation — a story of faith, love and redemption.
books.description: A modern Urdu classic that follows two young people whose search for meaning leads them in very different directions. Loved by readers across Pakistan for its emotional depth and spiritual themes, it remains a perfect gift and a must-have for every Urdu bookshelf.

books.title: Raja Gidh
books.short: Bano Qudsia’s landmark novel on morality, desire and the idea of ‘haram’ and ‘halal’.
books.description: Set in Lahore, this celebrated novel weaves together a university love story with a powerful allegory about honest and dishonest living. A cornerstone of modern Urdu literature and a favourite of students and serious readers alike.

books.title: Aangan
books.short: A family courtyard becomes a window onto the years before Partition.
books.description: Through the eyes of a young woman growing up in a joint family, Khadija Mastoor captures the politics, hopes and heartbreaks of the 1940s. Quiet, observant and deeply moving.

books.title: Udaas Naslain
books.short: An epic of the subcontinent from the First World War to Partition.
books.description: Abdullah Hussain’s sweeping debut follows a generation caught between empire, war and independence. Widely regarded as one of the finest Urdu novels ever written.

books.title: Aag Ka Darya
books.short: A river of time flowing through centuries of South Asian history.
books.description: Qurratulain Hyder’s ambitious masterpiece moves across eras with recurring characters, exploring identity, belonging and the cost of history. Essential reading for lovers of literary fiction.

books.title: Namal
books.short: A gripping legal and family drama from one of Pakistan’s most popular novelists.
books.description: Mystery, courtroom tension and spiritual reflection come together in this bestselling novel. Perfect for readers who can’t put a book down once they start.

books.title: Jannat Kay Pattay
books.short: A young woman’s journey abroad becomes a journey of the soul.
books.description: Adventure, romance and self-discovery in a fast-paced novel that has become a favourite among young readers across Pakistan.

books.title: Shahab Nama
books.short: The celebrated autobiography of a civil servant who witnessed the making of Pakistan.
books.description: Part memoir, part history, part spiritual reflection — this autobiography offers a rare inside view of Pakistan’s early decades and remains one of the most-read books in Urdu.

books.title: Zavia
books.short: Gentle wisdom and stories from Ashfaq Ahmed’s much-loved talks.
books.description: Collected from the popular television programme, these conversations share simple, profound lessons about kindness, patience and everyday life.

books.title: Manto Kay Afsanay
books.short: A selection of short stories by the fearless master of the Urdu afsana.
books.description: Including classics of Partition fiction, this selection shows why Manto remains one of the most powerful and honest storytellers of the subcontinent.

books.title: Bang-e-Dra
books.short: Allama Iqbal’s first Urdu poetry collection, including many of his best-loved poems.
books.description: From poems for children to stirring verses on selfhood and the Muslim world, Bang-e-Dra is an essential collection for every home library.

books.title: Deewan-e-Ghalib
books.short: The complete Urdu ghazals of Mirza Ghalib.
books.description: Wit, longing and philosophy in perfectly crafted couplets. A beautiful edition to read, recite and gift.

books.title: Naqsh-e-Faryadi
books.short: Faiz Ahmed Faiz’s first collection of poems.
books.description: Romance and revolution meet in the early poetry of one of Urdu’s most beloved voices.

books.title: The Reluctant Fundamentalist
books.short: A Lahore café, a stranger, and a story that changes everything.
books.description: Told as a single evening’s conversation in Lahore, Mohsin Hamid’s acclaimed novel explores identity, ambition and belonging in a post-9/11 world.

books.title: Exit West
books.short: A love story in a world of mysterious doors.
books.description: Two young people in an unnamed city find doors that lead to other places. A short, beautiful novel about migration and hope.

books.title: Ice-Candy-Man
books.short: Partition seen through the eyes of a young girl in Lahore.
books.description: Bapsi Sidhwa’s unforgettable novel blends humour and tragedy as a child narrator watches her city divided.

books.title: Home Fire
books.short: Family loyalty and the state collide in a prize-winning modern tragedy.
books.description: A gripping retelling of a classic tragedy, following three siblings and the choices that tear them apart.

books.title: I Am Malala
books.short: The memoir of the girl from Swat who stood up for education.
books.description: The inspiring true story of Malala’s childhood in the Swat Valley, her fight for girls’ education and her journey to becoming the youngest Nobel Peace Prize laureate.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.short: Tiny changes, remarkable results.
books.description: A practical, easy-to-follow guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones — one of the bestselling self-improvement books in the world.

books.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
books.short: What the rich teach their kids about money.
books.description: A classic personal-finance book that challenges common ideas about work, saving and investing.

books.title: The Alchemist
books.short: A shepherd boy’s journey to follow his dream.
books.description: A short, magical fable about listening to your heart and pursuing your destiny. Loved by millions of readers worldwide.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.short: How Homo sapiens came to rule the world.
books.description: A bold, readable tour through human history — from the first humans to the age of science and capitalism.

books.title: The Sealed Nectar
books.short: An award-winning biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
books.description: A clear, well-researched seerah that has become one of the most widely read biographies of the Prophet ﷺ in homes and madrassas around the world.

books.title: Tafheem-ul-Quran (Set)
books.short: The complete multi-volume Urdu tafseer.
books.description: A comprehensive, accessible commentary on the Holy Quran in Urdu. Supplied as a complete hardcover set — ideal for home and masjid libraries.

books.title: The Muqaddimah
books.short: The 14th-century introduction to history that founded the social sciences.
books.description: Ibn Khaldun’s brilliant study of societies, economies and the rise and fall of civilisations — still remarkably relevant today.

books.title: Jinnah of Pakistan
books.short: A detailed biography of Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah.
books.description: A well-known account of the life of the founder of Pakistan, from his early years as a lawyer to the creation of the nation.

books.title: Umro Ayyar Ki Kahaniyan
books.short: Magical adventures of the clever trickster from Dastan-e-Amir Hamza.
books.description: Retold for young readers, these much-loved tales of Umro Ayyar and his magical zambil are full of tricks, jinns and adventure.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.short: The boy who lived begins his first year at Hogwarts.
books.description: The first book in the much-loved series — the perfect way to turn young readers into book lovers.
